title: The deep entrenchment of animal‐source foods
content:
Abstract

Animal-source foods remain deeply entrenched within nutrition, livelihoods, and environmental debates. Effective policy depends on moving beyond calls for universal expansion or contraction, and instead addressing the specific trade-offs between nutrition, environmental sustainability, and social justice and equity. © 2026 Society of Chemical Industry.
